output_list.reason: The mintToken function has an integer overflow vulnerability. The totalSupply and balanceOf[_owner] are both increased by mintedAmount in the mintToken function, if mintedAmount is large enough, it will cause integer overflow, and the owner's balance will be incorrect.

The transfer function has an integer overflow vulnerability. The balanceOf[_from] is decreased by _value in the transfer function, if _value is large enough, it will cause integer overflow, and the balanceOf[_from] will be incorrect.

The transferFrom function has an integer overflow vulnerability. The balanceOf[_from] is decreased by _value in the transferFrom function, if _value is large enough, it will cause integer overflow, and the balanceOf[_from] will be incorrect.

The buy function has an integer overflow vulnerability. The amount is derived from msg.value / buyPrice, if buyPrice is set to a very large value, it will cause integer overflow, and the amount will be incorrect.
